findings.text: requirements.md does not exist in figma-claude-designs/ (only STATE.md and kit/brief*.md), so "met?" could not be checked against the owner's words; I judged the diff on its own.

The diff is two copies of one line: the same `.fig-stack > .fig-btn { align-self: flex-start; }` in FigmaTokens.mjs:53 and the generated tokens.css:132, so the generator and its output agree. The .mjs line uses a literal tab where its neighbours use "\t"; the output is identical, but the style differs.

Only direct-child buttons in a stack hug. A button inside a wrapper div in a stack still stretches, and a button meant to be full width in a stack would now need an override. The page.js:51-52 Stack demos are the intended case and work this way.
No screenshot was supplied, so I did not check the rendering at any width.
